title: Add RecipeFile value type
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeFile.swift. Defines the RecipeFile value type (url: URL, displayName: String, thumbnailURL: URL?) with Identifiable and Hashable conformances. Defines the FolderSection type (name: String, recipes: [RecipeFile]). Display-name derivation strips the .cook extension case-insensitively.
acceptance_criteria: RecipeFile compiles with url, displayName, thumbnailURL fields.
RecipeFile conforms to Identifiable and Hashable.
FolderSection type is defined as (name: String, recipes: [RecipeFile]).
Display-name derivation strips .cook extension case-insensitively (e.g. Pasta.COOK → Pasta).
